newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australia govt says poll win endorses budget.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australia govt says poll win endorses budget.

text.p: Australian Government Senate Leader Robert Hill said on Monday the Liberal Party's by-election victory on Saturday was an overwhelming endorsement of the government's budget programme.
"They (the voters) had the opportunity and they reinforced their vote," Hill told Australian Broadcasting Corp radio.
"There can be no greater endorsement, I would have thought, for a new government and its programme than the vote we received on Saturday," he said.
"There's no doubt in my mind that people want the programme enacted," Hill said.

Liberal candidate Jackie Kelly managed to retain her hold on the Sydney seat of Lindsay in the by-election on Saturday, returning with an increased majority, despite almost every factor favouring the Labor opposition.
Kelly won the seat in the March 2 election from Labor's Ross Free, who ran as the Labor candidate on Saturday.
She was later disqualified because she held New Zealand citizenship and a government job at the time of the election.
Hill said the victory would put pressure on other parties to pass the government's budget in the upper house Senate, where the government does not have a clear majority.
